turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
I know who you are. Who decided on the zero, and when?
It's barely past four-fifteen and I have until my call. You haven't answered me: who decided, and when?
Just say okay and I'll write it up as resolved. Okay?
No. Nothing is resolved until the zero comes off, and I'm still waiting for who decided.
No. You asked for this meeting, Hale, so run it: on what basis is Owen sitting at zero?
Ms. Kalinowski. I need you to say okay.
Saying it a fourth time doesn't make it an answer. Either you show me why he has a zero, or I walk down the hall to the principal.
